body: yes, some `overflow:auto` would be enough i think, @qiangxue ?
Perhaps someone who is good at CSS may help?

Maybe the entire toolbar could be displayed as `table` (I mean the css property `display: table`) and the panel as `table-cell`.
Those and a little tweaks results in this:

![ciudads 2014-01-03 00-05-47](https://f.cloud.github.com/assets/374554/1837239/0b12f600-7424-11e3-9b6e-d04deb0a2d4a.png)

Is not perfect but at least legible.
Some other things needs to be handled with javascript, as automatic padding when toolbar increases the height.
also @lucianobaraglia i dont get problem with pagination, can you point what exactly is not right there?

@Ragazzo the problem is not with the pagination, but the panels disappear from toolbar.
Only 3 panels are visible in that picture.
Don't use `display: table` please. It's logically incorrect and isn't widely supported.
